notes.explanation: These players were drafted, dropped, and never picked up by anyone by season's end - ESPN's API does not expose retroactive week-by-week rosters, so no point total OR POSITION is recoverable for them.
notes.value_score_formula: total_points * round_num (a simplification - rewards late-round picks that produced real points more than identical output from an early pick)
notes.qb_exclusion_note: QBs are EXCLUDED from best_value_picks, best_steals, and biggest_busts (both per-manager and league-wide). QBs are typically drafted late but score heavily due to fantasy point weighting, so value_score structurally favors them regardless of actual draft skill. QBs get their own 'captain_at_the_helm' category instead, ranked by raw total_points.
